description.en: Adds a Robots page to the sidebar. A robot is a directory the plugin creates under ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots and mounts as a DSH workspace; only robots created here are managed. For each robot you can install project-level skills through npx skills, edit its AGENTS.md, open its conversation, or re-mount it after the workspace was removed. Every robot also has a preset avatar (assigned on creation, changeable from the page), and the plugin exposes the ctx.bukaRobots service (list robots, avatar lookup, start a robot session, or continue an existing one by session id and compact its history first; new robot sessions are normal conversations attached to the robot workspace, so they appear in the sidebar) for other plugins such as Buka Workflows. Installing the plugin also adds the robot-builder mode: new sessions can pick 机器人构建, which asks what the robot should do, drafts its AGENTS.md, then creates and mounts the robot with the preset-only buka_robot_build tool; creating, editing and skill installation on the page keep working. A general-purpose robot sits at the top of the list: fixed 🤖 avatar, standard mode, enters any existing workspace; the page's Settings dialog enables or disables it (persisted in settings.json). Every robot also carries a one-sentence responsibility statement (like a skill description): the read-only buka_robots tool returns it so workflows can choose the robot. While enabled, the general-purpose robot also appears at the end of the workflow robot list with the same fields as any other robot; disabling it removes it from that list.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「机器人」页面。机器人是本插件在 ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots 下创建并挂载成 DSH 工作区的目录，只有这里创建的机器人才归插件管理。每个机器人可以用 npx skills 安装项目级 skills、编辑自己的 AGENTS.md、一键打开会话；工作区被删掉后还能重新挂载。每个机器人还带一个预设头像（新建时自动分配，详情页可更换），并通过 ctx.bukaRobots 服务向其他插件（例如 Buka Workflows）开放 list()、avatarMap() 与 startSession()（新会话是挂到机器人工作区的普通会话，侧边栏可见；可传 sessionId 续接同一个会话，续接前先 compact 历史）。安装插件还会多出一个「机器人构建」模式：新建会话时可选，它先问清机器人要做什么，起草 AGENTS.md，再用只对该模式可见的 buka_robot_build 工具创建并挂载机器人；页面上的新建、编辑 AGENTS.md 与安装 skills 照常可用。列表顶部还有一个通用型机器人：固定 🤖 头像、标准模式、可进入任意已有工作区；页面「设置」对话框里的开关决定它是否显示（开关存 settings.json）。每个机器人还带一句职责（对应 description 字段，类似 skill 的 description）：只读工具 buka_robots 会把它返回给编排器，工作流据此选择机器人。通用型机器人启用时也会出现在工作流机器人清单的最后，字段与普通机器人相同；停用后不再出现。
